text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, the FDA shortage list shows no shortage for rivaroxaban tablets. The sole rivaroxaban entry is a Janssen Pharmaceuticals suspension product listed as To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-09-18. Our three sites hold 147, 219, and 28 units respectively, providing 15, 23, and 13 days of supply at current use rates.

Why (FDA record): The label for NDC 62332034791 identifies Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3004956904) as the manufacturing plant, with its most recent inspection classified NAI on 2024-07-26. FDA inspection records for that plant show a series of VAI classifications from 2010 through 2020, with no OAI or recent NAI beyond 2024-07-26.

Our position: Because the links are weak and the product is not on the FDA shortage list, we must verify current allocation status with A-S Medication Solutions and confirm whether the Alembic-labeled NDC is the one we are receiving.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer contacts A-S Medication Solutions to verify allocation status and confirm NDC received; buyer approves.
2. Buyer confirms Alembic-labeled NDC receipt across all three sites; buyer approves.
3. Buyer evaluates ranked alternative suppliers (A-S Medication Solutions, Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, Aphena Pharma Solutions - Tennessee LLC, Apotex Corp., Aurobindo Pharma Limited) for purchase if allocation tightens; buyer approves with P&T committee notification.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
